label: src/domainProfile.ts full-file compaction
summary: Defines domain-neutral corpus bindings, evidence adapters, workspace surfaces, content presentation, element commands, and the aggregate domain profile contract.

sections.comment:
CorpusProfileContracts
|
+--> DOMAIN IDENTITY
|    +--> type BuiltInDomainProfileId = source-code | document
|    `--> type DomainProfileId = built-in | extension string
|
+--> CORPUS BINDING
|    `--> type CorpusBinding = git worktree | filesystem documents
|         `--> root + optional revision select concrete corpus
|
+--> DIRECTORY MODEL
|    +--> interface CorpusEntry { path; name; kind }
|    `--> interface CorpusDirectoryListing { directory; entries }
|
`--> PROVIDER
     `--> interface CorpusProvider
          +--> readonly kind
          +--> listDirectory(...)
          `--> readLines(...)

EvidenceProfileContracts
|
+--> ENTITY VIEW
|    `--> interface EvidenceEntity
|         `--> identity + label/kind/summary + source anchors
|
`--> SCHEMA ADAPTER
     `--> interface EvidenceSchema
          +--> display nouns identify evidence and collections
          `--> fromCodeEntity(...) -> EvidenceEntity

WorkspacePresentationContracts
|
+--> EXPLORER SURFACES
|    +--> type ExplorerSurfaceId = files | sets | sections | highlights | plans
|    `--> interface WorkspaceSurfaceContribution { id; label; domId }
|
+--> WORKSPACE PROFILE
|    `--> interface WorkspaceSurfaceProfile
|         `--> explorer tabs + supported DiagramViewKind list
|
`--> CONTENT PRESENTATION
     `--> interface ContentPresentation
          `--> highlighting + markdown mode + wrap + source compaction

DomainCommandProfile
|
+--> COMMAND IDENTITY
|    `--> type ElementCommandId = reveal | collapse | highlight | buffer
|
+--> COMMAND CONTRIBUTION
|    `--> interface ElementCommandContribution
|         `--> command id + representation kinds + optional evidence gate
|
`--> AGGREGATE PROFILE
     `--> interface DomainProfile
          +--> identity + corpus kind + EvidenceSchema
          +--> WorkspaceSurfaceProfile + ContentPresentation
          `--> readonly ElementCommandContribution[]
